caption: The drawing depicts a single brown glass bottle positioned upright on a plain, light tan background. The bottle has a long neck with a small mouth or opening at the top and a rounded shoulder that tapers to a cylindrical body. There are subtle highlights and reflections on the glass surface, indicating a glossy finish. Embossed lettering on the front of the bottle reads “Jung” in cursive and “BREW CO MILWAUKEE” in block letters below. A faded, partially visible label with a leafy or botanical motif is present near the upper portion of the body. The shading and coloration mainly consist of various shades of brown, with some darker and lighter areas used to create the illusion of transparency and depth. There are no additional objects or distinct background elements present. In the bottom right corner, there is a small artist’s signature with the year “1940.”
title: Beer Bottle
